title: Turning Parts Department OFF hides the 3 child cards
custom_preconds: 1. In the role editor, Parts Department is ON with the child cards configured (for example Part sales View + Create & Edit, Catalog and Inventory View, Vendor and order management View/Create & Edit/Delete).
custom_steps:
1. Turn Parts Department OFF.
  2. Look at the Parts Department card.
custom_expected: The 3 child cards are no longer shown inside the Parts Department card.
evidence: UI: on blank form the 3 child cards (Part sales/Catalog and Inventory/Vendor and order management) are absent; toggling Parts Department ON reveals all 3.
